name: sysinfo
description: Comprehensive PCM 3.1 diagnostic. Captures the system log (full + severity-filtered) with boot sequence, boot gates, errors and amplifier detection; the crash record; storage map with partition tables and drive geometry; amplifier resolution (which sound profile is actually live, and whether it matches the flag); odometer and vehicle data; activation codes; software identity and update history; service manager and listening ports; a full restorable /HBpersistence backup; plus the hardware/IPC/CAN/DSI device-tree probe. Read-only -- nothing on the car is modified. Also dumps the DSI service registry from /srv/servicebroker -- the broker's entire live list of registered interfaces and their versions, which no devctl can enumerate -- and the Bluetooth bring-up chain (serfpga, phone-db gate, scp_pss, address-book size, boot-hook and trace-profile presence), which is what determines whether the unit can pick Bluetooth at startup at all.
author: dspl1236
